interface.deleteTitle: Move Selected Item to Recycle Bin
interface.noFolderHint: Open an existing Glist project or create a new one.
interface.tagline: A focused development environment for Glist Engine.
interface.confirmCloseTerminal: Close {name}? What runs in it stops.
interface.engineMissing: GlistEngine was not found two folders above the project, where the build looks for it.
interface.pluginMissing: This plugin is named in CMakeLists.txt but is not in glistplugins, so the build will stop. Plugins can be downloaded from github.com/GlistPlugins.
interface.agentInstallYourself: Not installed. Its own installer sets it up for the whole computer.
interface.agentsHint: Coding assistants that work in the Agent tab, in the open project. Turn on the ones you want. One that is not installed can be installed here: it goes into the Glist folder, and nothing else on the computer changes.
interface.terminalRestartHint: Press any key to start a new one.
interface.initialOutput: Glist Studio is ready. Open a project to get started.
interface.noProjects: No projects here yet. Make one with New Project, or browse for a folder.
interface.ligatures: Join characters such as => where the font supports it
interface.fontsHint: Pick a font from the list or type the name of one installed on this computer.
interface.pathHint: The folders builds, runs, the debugger and the terminal look in for programs and DLLs, in this order. Glist Studio gives them its own list rather than the computer's PATH: Glist's tools, the system's folders and the plugins' DLLs, which cannot be changed here. Folders added here come last.
interface.hardwareAccelerationHint: Turn it off if the window flickers, stays blank or draws wrongly, as it can with some graphics drivers and virtual machines. It changes when Glist Studio starts again.
interface.hardwareAccelerationRestart: Restart Glist Studio for this to take effect.
interface.aboutNoBranch: None, a commit is checked out
interface.aboutHint: When you report a problem, Copy All and paste it into the report.
interface.runArgumentsHint: Given to {project}'s program when Run or Debug starts it. An argument with spaces goes in quotes.
interface.runArgumentsNoProject: Open a project to give its program arguments.
interface.envHint: Set for builds, runs, the debugger and the terminal, in every project. PATH has its own list above.
interface.envInvalid: A name is letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. PATH has its own list above.
interface.themeImportFailed: This file is not a VS Code color theme.
interface.editorLanguageRestart: The editor's find box and its own commands in the palette change language when Glist Studio starts again.
interface.themeHint: Themes color the whole studio. Color themes from VS Code (.json) can be imported.
interface.autoUpdateHint: New versions come from Glist Studio's releases on GitHub. One that has been downloaded is installed when Glist Studio restarts.
interface.updatePreviewsHint: Previews are built from every change to Glist Studio, before a release: the newest work, less tested.
interface.updateReady: Glist Studio {version} is ready to install.
interface.upToDate: Glist Studio is up to date.
interface.rollbackOpen: Roll Back to an Earlier Version...
interface.versionRollbackTitle: Roll Back to an Earlier Version
interface.rollbackIntro: For when a newer version does not work for you: Glist Studio goes back to the one chosen when it restarts.
interface.rollbackWarning: Settings this version saved may not work in an earlier one, and some may go back to their defaults. Your projects are not touched. The version you leave is not installed again by itself; a newer one will be.
interface.rollbackNone: There is no earlier version to go back to.
interface.rollbackReady: Glist Studio {version} is ready to go back to.
interface.updateHeld: You went back from {version}, so it is not installed again by itself. A newer version will be.
interface.glistMissing: Glist Engine is not installed on this computer yet.
interface.glistInstallIntro: This runs Glist Engine's own installer, the current one from github.com/GlistEngine/InstallScripts. It installs the compilers and libraries Glist needs, and puts the engine, an example app and the Glist tools in this folder. It downloads 1 to 2 GB.
interface.installPasswordSystem: If it needs this computer's password, the system asks for it in a window of its own; Glist Studio never sees it.
interface.installPasswordTerminal: If it needs this computer's password, type it in the terminal that appears below.
interface.starText: Glist Engine is free and open source. A star on GitHub helps more people find it, and tells the people who make it that it is used.
interface.confirmStopInstall: Stop the installation? What it has done so far stays, and installing again continues from there.
interface.scaleHint: Makes everything in the studio larger or smaller, for example on a classroom projector.
interface.noCmake: CMakeLists.txt was not found in this folder.
interface.confirmDeleteFile: Move this file to the Recycle Bin?
interface.confirmDeleteFolder: Move this folder and all its contents to the Recycle Bin?
interface.confirmDeleteItems: Move {count} selected items to the Recycle Bin?
interface.confirmDirtyDelete: Unsaved changes in this item will be lost. Continue?
interface.classLocation: Select a folder for the C++ class.
interface.transientTab: Closes when you switch to another tab. Double-click to keep it open.
interface.editOutsideProject: The change touches files outside the project and was not applied.
interface.noBreakpoints: Click to the left of a line number to stop there while debugging.
interface.debugIdle: Debug runs your app so you can pause it, look at its variables, and go line by line.
interface.debugStarting: Building for debugging and starting the debugger...
interface.debuggerFailed: The debugger could not be started
interface.debuggerInstalledText: {name} {version}, from MSYS2, is installed for debugging.
interface.debuggerNotInstalled: Glist's tools have no debugger on Windows. Glist Studio can install {name} from MSYS2, the source of Glist's compilers, with every file checked against a pinned checksum ({size}).
interface.debuggerReady: GDB is installed. Press Debug to start.
interface.debuggerFailedNotice: GDB could not start. Installing it again usually fixes that.
interface.gitHint: Adds a Commit view beside the explorer, a Git tab below the editor and the current branch to the title bar, and marks changed lines beside the line numbers. Projects stay as they are until you use them.
interface.gitNotFound: Git was not found on this computer. Install it from git-scm.com, then open Settings again.
interface.gitIdentityHint: Commits are signed with these, in every project on this computer.
interface.gitUpdateMethod: Update Project brings in commits from the remote by
interface.gitUpdateRebase: Putting the branch's own commits after them (rebase)
interface.gitProtectHint: A commit that is already pushed cannot be amended, and protected branches cannot be force pushed, so nobody rewrites history others already have.
interface.gitProtectedHint: Separated by commas; * stands for any text, as in release/*. Branches GitHub protects are protected too.
interface.amendLocked: The last commit is already pushed, so it cannot be amended.
interface.forcePushLocked: {branch} is protected, so it is never overwritten.
interface.noChanges: No changes since the last commit.
interface.confirmRollback: Put {count} files back as they were in the last commit? Your changes to them will be lost. Files that are new go to the trash.
interface.confirmRollbackOne: Put {name} back as it was in the last commit? Your changes to it will be lost.
interface.conflictHint: Open a file to choose change by change, or keep one side for the whole file.
interface.noRepository: This project does not keep its history with Git yet.
interface.noRepositoryHint: With a repository, you save versions of the project as commits, can go back to any of them, and can share the project.
interface.updateAskHint: {source} has new commits, and {name} has work of yours: {work}.
interface.updateKeepFiles: Keep my changes: bring in the new commits, then put my changed files back
interface.updateKeepRebase: Keep my work: put my commits on top of the new ones
interface.updateKeepMerge: Keep my work: merge the new commits with mine
interface.updateKeepMergeWhy: Yours are on {branch}, which is protected, so they are merged rather than rewritten.
interface.updateKeepRebasePushed: Yours are on {branch} already; after this, sending them there again needs a force push.
interface.updateReplace: Use the version on {source}: my commits stay on a branch of their own, my changed files in Stashes
interface.updateReplaceFiles: Use the version on {source}: my changed files go to Stashes
interface.updateReplaceCommits: Use the version on {source}: my commits stay on a branch of their own
interface.updateDoneRebase: {name} is updated from {source}, with your commits on top.
interface.updateDoneMerge: {name} is updated from {source}, merged with your commits.
interface.updateKeptStash: Your changed files are in Stashes as "{stash}".
interface.updateKeptBranch: Your commits are on the branch {branch}.
interface.updateStashClash: Your changed files clash with the new version, so they wait in Stashes, in the Git tab.
interface.engineNoSource: None of its remotes is {source}, so it is not updated from there.
interface.engineNotFound: There is no Glist Engine at {location}.
interface.engineNotCheckout: The engine at {location} is not a Git checkout, so it is not updated from here.
interface.pluginUseFailed: {name} could not be added to the project
interface.pluginsNeedGit: Installing and updating plugins needs Git. Install it from git-scm.com.
interface.readmeFailed: The README could not be loaded
interface.imageFailed: The image could not be shown
interface.modelFailed: The model could not be shown
interface.modelNoWebgl: Models are drawn with WebGL, which this computer or its graphics settings do not offer. Turning hardware acceleration back on in Settings > General may help.
interface.modelHint: Drag to turn it, right-drag to move it, scroll to zoom
interface.mediaFailed: The file could not be opened
interface.mediaVideoUnplayable: This video's format cannot be played here.
interface.mediaAudioUnplayable: This sound's format cannot be played here.
interface.mediaWaveTooLong: This sound is too long to draw its waveform.
interface.mediaWaveFailed: The waveform could not be drawn.
interface.databaseFailed: The database could not be opened
interface.databaseEmpty: This database has no tables yet.
interface.databaseFilter: Filter with an SQL condition, such as score > 10, then Enter
interface.databaseRunHint: Ctrl+Enter runs what is selected, or all of it, one statement after another.
interface.databasePendingOpen: A transaction is open on {name}, not committed yet
interface.databaseSaveBeforeClosing: Save the changes to {name} before closing? Not saving discards them.
interface.databaseChangesLost: Changes to {name} that were not committed are lost.
interface.databaseDiffFailed: The versions could not be compared
interface.databaseDiffRowsError: Its rows could not be compared: {error}
interface.databaseDiffCommonColumns: Rows are compared on the columns both versions have.
interface.databaseDiffByRowid: This table has no primary key, so rows are matched by their row number.
interface.databaseDiffByColumns: Its primary key changed, so rows are matched by all their columns: a changed row shows as removed and added.
interface.databaseDiffLfs: {version}: stored with Git LFS, so it cannot be compared here.
interface.databaseDiffWaiting: This diff shows {name} as saved. The changes waiting in its tab are not in it until they are committed.
interface.databaseDiffRollbackWaiting: Put {name} back as it was in the last commit? Your changes to it will be lost, and the changes waiting in its tab are discarded too.
interface.gitNoProject: Open a project to see its changes.
interface.gitMissing: Git was not found on this computer. Install it from git-scm.com.
interface.diffBinary: This file is not text, so there are no lines to compare.
interface.diffTooLarge: This file is too large to compare.
interface.toggleSideBySide: Side by Side or One Column
interface.selectCommit: Select a commit to see what it changed.
interface.patchCopiedCommits: {count} commits copied to the clipboard as a patch.
interface.patchNothing: There is nothing to put in a patch: merge commits have none of their own.
interface.patchNotOne: This file is not a patch.
interface.patchNotInClipboard: The clipboard has no patch in it.
interface.resetMixed: Keep the changes of the later commits, as changes not committed yet
interface.resetSoft: Keep them, ready to be committed again
interface.resetHard: Throw away the later commits and every change not committed
interface.confirmResetHard: Throw away the later commits and all changes not committed? This cannot be undone.
interface.confirmForceDelete: {name} has commits that are in no other branch. Delete it anyway? They will be lost.
interface.confirmDeleteRemoteBranch: Delete {name} from the remote? Everyone using it loses it.
interface.confirmRemoveRemote: Remove the remote {name} from this repository? Nothing on the remote itself is deleted.
interface.noRemotes: No remotes yet. Add one to push the project somewhere, such as GitHub.
interface.confirmDropStash: Delete {name}? The changes in it will be lost.
interface.noStashes: Nothing is stashed. Stashing puts your changes aside, so you can work on something else and bring them back later.
interface.confirmDropCommit: Drop the commit "{subject}"? Its changes leave this branch. It has not been pushed, so nothing changes on the remote.
interface.confirmDeleteNewFiles: Delete {count} new files? They go to the trash.
interface.stashFilesHint: {count} files, put aside to bring back later from Stashes.
interface.changesStashed: Changes stashed. They are in Stashes, in the Git tab.
interface.pushNothing: There are no commits to push.
interface.pushNewBranch: The branch is new on the remote, and will follow it from now on.
interface.forcePushHint: Only for commits that were changed after they were pushed. Commits others pushed since would be lost.
interface.identityHint: Git records a name and an email with each commit. They are kept for every project on this computer, and can be changed in Settings.
interface.conflictsNotice: There are conflicts to resolve. They are listed in the Commit view.
interface.linesAdded: These lines are new since the last commit.
interface.blameUnavailable: This file has no committed history yet.
interface.blameClick: Click the line number to show the commit in the Git log.
interface.confirmShared: {name} is shared by every project that uses it, so this changes it for all of them. Continue?
interface.confirmUpdateDependencies: Bring in the latest commits of {names} from where they are published? Every project that uses them gets the changes.
interface.sharedChanges: Changes in {name}, which every project that uses it shares. They are committed to its own repository.
interface.sharedEdit: {name} is shared by every project that uses it, so saving changes it for all of them.
interface.autoConfigure: Configure again when CMake files change
interface.autoConfigureHint: When CMakeLists.txt or another CMake file of the project, the engine or its plugins changes, CMake configures the project again a moment later, so code completion knows new files without a build.
interface.showTargetsHint: Adds a list beside Run of every target CMake builds, the engine's and plugins' too, as CLion has. Build, Run and Debug then use the one chosen.
interface.clearOutputOnRun: Clear the output for each build and run
interface.clearOutputOnRunHint: The ones before stay in the list beside the Output tab's tools, with when each started and how it ended.
interface.formatOnSave: Format the lines you changed in C++ files when saving
interface.formatOnSaveHint: Saving formats only the lines changed since the last save, in the style chosen, and leaves the order of #include lines as it is. Edit > Reformat File formats a whole file, or the lines chosen.
interface.buildNotice: Build this project once so the editor can find Glist Engine's files. Until then it shows no errors in the code.
interface.findInFilesPlaceholder: Text to find in the files
interface.findScopeAll: In the project, engine and plugins
interface.findInvalidRegex: This regular expression is not valid.
interface.searchEverywhereHint: Type to search files, classes, functions and commands. Tab moves between the kinds.
interface.searchSymbolsHint: Type the name of a class, function or variable.
interface.searchSymbolsBuild: Build the project once, then its classes and functions can be searched.
interface.searchSymbolsOff: Symbols come from clangd, which is not running.
interface.crashArithmetic: Crashed: a calculation it cannot do, as dividing by zero
interface.crashInstruction: Crashed: an instruction it cannot run
interface.crashHint: The program stopped here because it crashed. Point at the names on this line to see their values, and see the call stack in Run and Debug.
interface.reformatNoStyle: There is no .clang-format in this file's folder or a folder above it, so there is no layout to format it by. Add one to the project's folder.
interface.reformatDisabled: This file's .clang-format says not to format it (DisableFormat).
interface.reformatUnavailable: The file could not be formatted: clangd, which formats it, is not running or did not answer.
interface.reformatMistake: The file has a mistake, so it was left as it is
interface.codeStyleHint: Glist Engine's style is how the engine itself is written. Projects without a .clang-format use it too.
interface.reformatOff: Code formatting is off: Settings > Code Formatting chooses a style.
interface.showMinimap: Show the minimap beside the code
interface.stickyScroll: Keep the first line of the function, class or block at the top while scrolling
interface.hiddenFolders: Files and folders hidden in the explorer and search
interface.hiddenFoldersHint: Separated by commas; * stands for any text, as in cmake-build-*. Clear a name to see it again. Changes to them stay out of a commit until you tick them.
interface.reduceMotionHint: Stills the caret and scrolling in the editor and the interface's animations. It starts as the system has it.
interface.backendRestarted: Glist Studio's background work stopped unexpectedly and was started again. The project is open again.
interface.copyByHand: It could not be put on the clipboard. Select it and copy it yourself.
interface.unexpectedError: Glist Studio ran into an unexpected error
interface.debugInfoCopied: Debug info copied. Paste it into your report.
interface.logsFolderOnServer: The logs are in this folder, on the computer running the server.
interface.logsFolderFailed: Could not open the logs folder
interface.repairIntro: Glist Studio checks what could be wrong and fixes what it can.
interface.repairReloadUnsaved: Changed files could not be saved, so the window was not reloaded.
interface.repairNotAnswering: Glist Studio's background work is not answering.
interface.repairFixedSome: Some things were fixed; the ones marked need you.
interface.repairSkippedBackend: Skipped: background work is not answering.
interface.repairBackendRestartedBefore: It stopped by itself earlier and was started again. It is answering now.
interface.repairBackendWaiting: It stopped just now. Waiting for it to start again…
interface.repairBackendStartedAgain: It had stopped and was started again. It is answering now.
interface.repairBackendRestarting: It is not answering. Starting it again…
interface.repairBackendRestarted: Background work was not answering. It was started again, and the project is open again.
interface.repairBackendRestartFailed: Background work was not answering, and starting it again did not help. Quit Glist Studio and open it again.
interface.repairBackendKept: Background work is not answering. It was not started again, so the changes to {name} still wait. If it stays like this, run Repair IDE again.
interface.repairRestartLosesDatabase: Background work is not answering, so the changes to {name} cannot be committed. Starting it again loses them. Start it again?
interface.repairFilesNotSaved: Changed files could not be saved. They are still open with your changes.
interface.repairServerOk: The Glist Studio server is answering.
interface.repairServerSilent: The Glist Studio server is not answering. Restart it where it runs (npm run web), then reload this page.
interface.repairServerGone: This page lost its connection to the Glist Studio server. Start the server again if it stopped (npm run web), then reload this page.
interface.repairClangdNoBuild: It needs the project built once to know its files. Build it with Ctrl+Shift+B.
interface.repairClangdRestarted: It had stopped. It was started again.
interface.repairClangdStuck: It was not answering. It was started again with a fresh index, which it builds again in the background.
interface.repairClangdFailed: It could not be started. Check that clangd is installed.
interface.repairIndexRebuilding: Deleting the index and starting code help again…
interface.repairIndexRebuilt: The index was deleted. Code help builds it again in the background, which takes a few minutes.
interface.repairGitOff: Skipped: the Git tools are off in Settings.
interface.repairGitOk: No lock files are left behind.
interface.repairGitRemoved: Git had left a lock file in {name}, which stopped every Git action. It was removed.
interface.repairGitStale: Git left a lock file in {name}, which stops every Git action.
interface.repairGitBusy: Git is still running in {name}, maybe in a terminal. Let it finish or close it, then run Repair IDE again.
interface.repairGitRecent: Git started changing {name} moments ago. If Git actions still fail in a minute, run Repair IDE again.
interface.repairGitFailed: The lock file in {name} could not be removed: {error}
interface.repairGitMissing: Git is not installed, so the Git tools cannot work.
interface.repairProcessesOk: They are as the window shows them.
interface.repairBuildTidied: The window still showed a build that had ended. Now it does not.
interface.repairBuildFound: A build was running that the window did not show. Stop can end it now.
interface.repairRunTidied: The window still showed a program running that had ended. Now it does not.
interface.repairRunFound: A program was running that the window did not show. Stop can end it now.
interface.repairDebugTidied: The debugger had stopped without the window knowing. Now it shows it stopped.
interface.repairTerminalEnded: A terminal had ended without the window knowing. Press a key in it to start a new one.
interface.repairShellEnded: A terminal was still running with no tab showing it. It was ended.
interface.repairGlistOk: They are where the project's build looks for them.
interface.repairEngineMissing: Glist Engine was not found where the project's build looks for it: {path}
interface.repairPluginsMissing: Plugins the project uses are not downloaded: {name}
interface.repairSettingsReset: Some saved settings could not be read ({name}), so they were reset.
interface.repairStorageBroken: The window cannot save settings: its storage is full or blocked.
interface.repairEditorOk: It is working. If it still acts up, reload the window: files are saved first and the tabs come back.
interface.repairEditorErrors: The window ran into unexpected errors since it opened. Reload it to start the editor afresh: files are saved first and the tabs come back.

git.notRepository: This project is not in a Git repository.
git.alreadyRepository: This project is already in a Git repository.
git.rebaseCommit: A rebase is in progress: resolve the conflicts, then choose Continue.
git.unresolved: Resolve the conflicts first, and mark the files resolved.
git.invalidRevision: This is not a commit, branch or tag.
git.invalidUrl: Enter the address of a repository, such as https://github.com/user/project.git.
git.outsideRepository: This file is not in the repository.
git.projectExists: A folder with this name already exists there.
git.identity: Git needs your name and email for commits. Set them in Settings, under Git.
git.localChanges: Your changes to some files would be lost. Commit or stash them first.
git.notMerged: This branch has commits that are in no other branch.
git.dropOtherBranch: Only a commit of the current branch can be dropped.

plugins.readmeTooLarge: This README is too large to show.
plugins.notPublished: {name} is not in the plugin list.
plugins.noPluginList: CMakeLists.txt has no set(PLUGINS ...) to add it to.

updates.notFromSource: {name} was not installed from {source}, and none of its remotes is {source}, so it is not updated from there. Its Git tools can update it from its own remotes.
updates.otherBranch: {name} is on the branch {branch}; updates are for {main}.
updates.detached: {name} is on a commit rather than a branch, so it is not updated.
updates.conflicts: The changes in {name} conflict with the new ones from {source}.
